editorial.title_zh: Mysteel：九江萍钢和临沂特钢拟于12月检修，中厚板及优特钢棒材供应受关注
editorial.title_en: Mysteel reports December maintenance plans for Jiujiang plate and Linyi special-bar lines
editorial.summary_zh: Mysteel 11月26日早读称，方大九江萍钢计划12月16日至30日检修中厚板线，预计影响产量8万吨。临沂特钢拟12月1日至31日轮修两座转炉并改造棒材线，预计影响直径28至160毫米的优特钢棒材9万至10万吨。Mysteel另报天津钢铁12月安排单线或双线检修，预计影响当月产量12万吨。上述为计划和估算。早读所引11月25日外交部答问重申协商立场，USTR有关301税率已在独立主条记录为提案。
editorial.summary_en: Mysteel’s 26 November overview reports planned plate-line maintenance at Fangda Jiujiang Pinggang on 16–30 December, with estimated output losses of 80,000 tonnes. Linyi Special Steel plans converter maintenance and a bar-line upgrade on 1–31 December, with an estimated impact of 90,000–100,000 tonnes for 28–160 mm quality and special steel bars. Tianjin Iron & Steel’s December maintenance is reported to affect about 120,000 tonnes of output. These figures are planned impacts. China’s foreign ministry reiterated its consultation position on the separate USTR proposal.
editorial.impact_zh: 有相关钢厂的中厚板或优特钢棒材12月订单时，向钢厂确认检修前可锁轧期、备坯和装船窗口。复核交期后再承诺新单，涉及替代钢厂时先确认客户认可的牌号和认证范围。
editorial.impact_en: For exposed December plate or special-bar bookings, confirm rolling slots, feedstock and vessel windows with the producing mill. Check customer qualification and grade coverage before switching suppliers.
editorial.coverage: 核对Mysteel原文公开索引及11月25日分项检修稿（https://news.mysteel.com/a/26112517/096E0C85530242EF.html），与方大九江萍钢专题及临沂特钢检修信息交叉核对。检修及影响量均按Mysteel报道归因。中国外交部原文：https://www.mfa.gov.cn/web/gjhdq_676201/gjhdqzz_681964/zgzyjz_148218/fyrth_688966/202611/t20261125_12066982.shtml。源站以北京时间标注11月26日07:37，队列UTC日期为11月25日。
editorial.follow_up: 按钢厂最新排产确认检修实际执行及订单交期。

editorial.title_zh: 韩国国会钢铁论坛讨论进口限制和本国钢材采购优先，产业部长提出强化粗钢产地信息
editorial.title_en: South Korean parliamentary steel forum discusses import restrictions, local procurement and crude-steel origin reporting
editorial.summary_zh: 韩国国会钢铁论坛于11月25日举办政策研讨会，韩国钢铁协会参与。韩国工业研究院研究员 Lee Jae-yoon（이재윤）在会上建议研究对钢材实行较广泛的进口限制，公共基础设施和能源项目优先考虑韩国本国钢材，并考虑将钢铁纳入国内生产税收抵免。行业媒体另引韩国产业通商部长金正官称，将推进粗钢生产国信息提交制度。会议讨论和部长发言尚无新税率、适用税号或报关起始日期。
editorial.summary_en: A South Korean National Assembly Steel Forum seminar on 25 November discussed broader steel import restrictions, preference for Korean steel in public infrastructure and energy projects, and extending domestic production tax credits to steel. Trade press separately reported that Industry Minister Kim Jung-kwan called for formalising reporting of the country where crude steel is produced. The reported discussion sets no new tariff rate, tariff code or customs start date.
editorial.impact_zh: 对输韩中厚板、热轧及面向基础设施客户的钢材，报价按现行措施核算。涉及第三国加工时，可先整理钢厂、炉号和粗钢生产地资料，并请韩国进口商跟踪产业通商部和海关是否发布申报字段或适用税号。
editorial.impact_en: For Korean plate, HRC and infrastructure orders, price under the measures currently in force. For third-country processing, retain mill, heat and crude-steel production country evidence and have the importer monitor Korean ministry and customs instructions.
editorial.coverage: 核对韩国钢铁协会活动信息的公开索引，并用SteelIN完整会议信息（https://www.steelin.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=13646）和《钢铁金属新闻》对部长发言的报道（https://www.snmnews.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=577912）交叉核对。所述进口及采购建议为报告人主张，熔炼生产地信息要求未见发布实施文件。
editorial.follow_up: 后续仅在主管机关发布具体草案、产品范围或生效日期时更新贸易影响。

editorial.title_zh: 青岛62%铁矿石CFR评估报89.2美元每吨，大商所主力11月25日收657元
editorial.title_en: Qingdao 62% iron ore benchmark assessed at USD 89.20/t CFR; Dalian main contract ended 25 November at CNY 657/t
editorial.summary_zh: IndexBox转引Kallanish称，11月20日青岛62%品位铁矿石CFR评估为89.20美元/吨，较10月23日下降2%。报道所述四年低位对应11月中旬期货走势；中国煤炭资源网记录大商所铁矿石I2701合约11月16日盘中低点647.5元/吨。路透11月25日报道，大商所当日成交最活跃合约日盘收657元/吨。现货评估、期货盘中低点及日盘收盘采用不同市场与观察时点。
editorial.summary_en: IndexBox cited a Kallanish assessment of USD 89.20/t CFR Qingdao for 62% Fe ore on 20 November, 2% below 23 October. The four-year low refers to mid-November futures; Sxcoal reported an intraday low of CNY 647.50/t for Dalian I2701 on 16 November. Reuters reported a CNY 657/t daytime close for the most-traded Dalian contract on 25 November.
editorial.impact_zh: 铁矿走弱只影响钢厂成本的一部分。热卷、中厚板报价请保留现行实盘，并同步检查焦炭、钢厂排产和海运成本，待钢厂重新报价再判断是否调价。
editorial.impact_en: Treat softer iron ore as one input into steelmaking costs. For export HRC and plate, check coke, mill scheduling and freight and use fresh firm mill offers for repricing.
editorial.coverage: 核对IndexBox全文中Kallanish品位、港口、CFR条件和比价日期；对照中国煤炭资源网大商所行情（https://en.sxcoal.com/news/detail/2122234472789368834）及Mining Weekly刊载的路透报道（https://www.miningweekly.com/article/iron-ore-rangebound-coal-hits-one-month-high-on-supply-concerns-2026-11-25/page:2）。现货底表未独立复算，盘中和日盘报价分别归因。
editorial.follow_up: 跟踪铁矿现货、焦炭和钢厂实盘是否同步变化。

editorial.title_zh: 加拿大钢材经销商反映超配额减免审批困难，特殊钢材继续按个案审查
editorial.title_en: Canadian steel distributors report difficulty obtaining case-by-case TRQ surtax relief
editorial.summary_zh: 11月25日报道引述加拿大钢材经销商Titus Steel与Cascadia Metals对超配额附加税减免个案的经历。Titus称其进口特定油淬钢的申请被拒，Cascadia称部分申请未获批准或答复。加拿大财政部现行程序规定，对加拿大、美国和墨西哥以外原产的适用钢材，超过配额的50%附加税在特殊情形下可提出逐案减免申请。财政部可咨询本地钢厂，申请应提供加拿大无法供应同规格或替代品的证据，减免需由总督会同行政会议批准减免令后生效。该程序与11月17日公布的拟扩大部分中国钢铝25%附加税减免安排的法律依据分别核对。
editorial.summary_en: A 25 November report cited distributors Titus Steel and Cascadia Metals on denied or unresolved tariff remission requests. Finance Canada assesses requests for relief from the 50% above-quota surtax in exceptional circumstances, including demonstrated lack of domestic production capability for a specific product. A remission order requires approval by the Governor in Council. The separate China surtax remission expansion announced on 17 November has its own legal basis.
editorial.impact_zh: 中国耐磨板、特殊钢或定制规格订单，先由加拿大进口商按10位税号、TRQ类别、当季配额、逐票许可及加拿大替代供应核算。若拟申请减免，请准备钢厂询价回复、技术要求和本地替代不可行证据。报价按实际适用附加税预算，在取得书面减免前保留税费调整条款。加拿大海关示例显示同一报关货物同时触发50% TRQ附加税和25%中国附加税时，仅适用TRQ附加税，反倾销等另核。
editorial.impact_en: For Chinese abrasion-resistant plate or specialty steel, have the importer check the 10-digit code, TRQ class, quarterly balance, shipment-specific permit and domestic substitutes. Document sourcing attempts before applying. Use the applicable duties in quotes pending written relief. CBSA’s example applies only the TRQ surtax when the same goods trigger both the TRQ and China surtaxes, with anti-dumping duties assessed separately.
editorial.coverage: 《环球邮报》原站受限，阅读全文转述（https://www.thecanadianvanguard.com/steel-distributors-claim-they-are-being-denied-owed-tariff-rebates/），企业个案按受访者陈述记录，未取得审批决定书。与加拿大财政部申请流程、CBSA 25-24号公告第5段和例4（https://www.cbsa-asfc.gc.ca/publications/cn-ad/cn25-24-eng.html）及11月17日总理办公室背景说明（https://www.pm.gc.ca/en/news/backgrounders/2026/11/17/prime-minister-carney-advances-canadas-strategic-partnership-china）核对各项措施。
editorial.follow_up: 取得进口商对具体规格、配额预留和是否已有减免令的书面确认。

triage.reason_zh: Steel Market Update公开正文仅有协会认为拟议措施力度不足的导语，未取得AISI就11月25日决定发表的完整声明或新的具体诉求。USTR提案已有独立核验条目。
triage.coverage: 核对SMU公开段落（https://www.steelmarketupdate.com/2026/11/25/section-301-tariff-decisions-disappoint-aisi/）、AISI既有政策页（https://www.steel.org/public-policy/trade/）及USTR 11月25日公告（https://www.ustr.gov/about/policy-offices/press-office/press-releases/2026/november/ustr-makes-determinations-and-proposes-actions-14-section-301-investigations-relating-structural）。既有游说立场无法独立证明协会本次回应的全文，暂按有限证据保留。
